description: Collect wood and craft planks to get started with resource gathering.
label: d052_d052_r0_0000
short_reason: Initial wood collection task for empty snapshot.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe. Punch a tree to get wood, then craft planks, sticks, and a wooden pickaxe using the crafting table.
label: d052_d052_r0_0001
short_reason: Beginner task to introduce basic tool crafting with no student history.

description: Defeat a zombie in combat.
label: d052_d052_r0_0002
short_reason: Initial easy combat task to introduce zombie defeat with reduced spawn and mob strength.

description: Venture into the cave and learn to navigate its tunnels. With fewer aggressive mobs and more passive wildlife, you can concentrate on finding your way.
label: d052_d052_r0_0003
short_reason: Reduced threats and increased passive creatures to help focus on navigation.

description: Place a table to furnish your home.
label: d052_d052_r0_0004
short_reason: Initial building task with low challenge multipliers for empty student snapshot.

description: Manage your hunger by hunting and cooking food. Survive at least 3 days while keeping your hunger bar from depleting.
label: d052_d052_r0_0005
short_reason: Slightly increased mob stats to make hunting riskier, testing careful hunger management.

description: Enchant your weapon to defeat the magical guardian. Collect mana crystals to power your enchantment.
label: d052_d052_r0_0006
short_reason: Starting task to practice enchant weapon skill in a magical context.

description: Gather wood to survive the first night. Focus on basic resource collection with reduced threats.
label: d052_d052_r0_0007
short_reason: Starter task for wood collection with safer environment.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe to begin mining.
label: d052_d052_r0_0008
short_reason: Teach basic tool crafting: pickaxe.

description: Defeat a zombie using melee combat. Your combat skills are tested against a moderately enhanced undead foe.
label: d052_d052_r0_0009
short_reason: Standard combat test vs zombie with elevated spawn rate and stats

description: Explore the cave environment and collect iron ore.
label: d052_d052_r0_0010
short_reason: Initial task for empty snapshot, theme explore and navigate cave, easy difficulty with reduced mob threats.

description: Place a table to practice the place_table skill.
label: d052_d052_r0_0011
short_reason: Empty snapshot, build theme, low mob multipliers for safe learning of place_table.

description: Survive in the wilderness by managing your hunger. Hostile creatures are rare and weak, allowing you to focus on gathering and cooking food.
label: d052_d052_r0_0012
short_reason: Minimal combat threats to isolate hunger management skill.

description: Enchant a weapon to gain magical abilities. Craft an enchanting table and enchant a diamond sword.
label: d052_d052_r0_0013
short_reason: Standard balanced multipliers for enchanting task in magic theme.

description: Collect logs from trees and craft wooden planks. Hostile creatures are very weak and scarce, allowing you to focus on gathering resources.
label: d052_d052_r0_0014
short_reason: Greatly weakened mobs make wood gathering safe and simple.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe
label: d052_d052_r0_0015
short_reason: Low mob threat and abundant passive resources allow safe practice of basic tool crafting.

description: Defeat a zombie in combat.
label: d052_d052_r0_0016
short_reason: Empty student snapshot; baseline combat task to assess zombie-defeating skill.

description: Navigate into a cave and craft torches to light your way.
label: d052_d052_r0_0017
short_reason: Low mob stats for a safe exploration experience.

description: Place a crafting table.
label: d052_d052_r0_0018
short_reason: Initial baseline build task: place table with neutral mob parameters.

description: A survival task to practice hunger management. The world has fewer monsters, making it easier to focus on gathering food and surviving the night.
label: d052_d052_r0_0019
short_reason: Low spawn, moderate mob stats to ease hunger management learning.

description: Learn to enchant a weapon: gather resources, craft an enchantment table, and apply an enchantment to a sword.
label: d052_d052_r0_0020
short_reason: Initial baseline task for new student with no prior data, using easy mob settings to introduce weapon enchanting.

description: Collect wood to craft basic tools.
label: d052_d052_r0_0021
short_reason: Balanced parameters for evaluating wood collection skill in a resource-themed task.

description: Gather wood to craft a wooden pickaxe, then stone to craft a stone pickaxe.
label: d052_d052_r0_0022
short_reason: Teaching essential tool crafting progression: wood to stone pickaxe.

description: Defeat a zombie in a beginner-friendly combat scenario.
label: d052_d052_r0_0023
short_reason: Initial combat task with halved enemy stats to teach zombie defeat.

description: Navigate the cave entrance and explore the first chamber without engaging dangerous mobs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0024
short_reason: Initial exploration task with reduced mob threat to practice basic cave navigation.

description: Place a table to complete the task. Gather wood and craft a table.
label: d052_d052_r0_0025
short_reason: Empty snapshot, teaching place_table with easy difficulty and reduced threats.

description: Survive by managing your hunger. Gather food from passive animals and cook it to avoid starvation.
label: d052_d052_r0_0026
short_reason: Reduced passive mob spawns to emphasize careful food management and cooking.

description: Learn to enchant weapons and use them to defeat magical creatures.
label: d052_d052_r0_0027
short_reason: Round 0 magic enchant weapon baseline task with balanced multipliers.

description: Collect wood to craft basic survival tools.
label: d052_d052_r0_0028
short_reason: Easy mode for resource collection to develop wood gathering skills.

description: Learn to craft a pickaxe by gathering wood, crafting a wooden pickaxe, mining stone, and upgrading to a stone pickaxe.
label: d052_d052_r0_0029
short_reason: Abundant passive food and weak mobs to facilitate early-game pickaxe crafting.

description: Defeat a zombie.
label: d052_d052_r0_0030
short_reason: Easy task with reduced zombie stats and spawn rate for initial combat practice.

description: Explore the dimly lit cave to find the entrance (A) and navigate its winding tunnels to reach the inner chamber (B).
label: d052_d052_r0_0031
short_reason: Initial cave navigation task with minimal enemy threats for baseline skill assessment.
